title: Master card: master meter
comments: Stereo peak meter after the master level: 12 segments per side, 0 = +4 dBu, clip +13 dB (about +17 dBu)
Per side: two superdiodes into 1u via 1k (about 1 ms attack), 680k fall (20 dB in about 1.5 s), follower
One shared 1 % ladder from +15 V (within 0.04 dB); LEDs about 2 mA from +5 V into LM339 outputs (PGND)
